crew.name: Front-Wheel Frankie
crew.bio: A wiry raccoon who hasn't touched his front tire to the street since spring.
race_barks: Watch me ride the sky down Pratt!
You pedal, I float. Big difference.

crew.name: Kickstand Kev
crew.bio: A stocky bulldog who claims he invented the curb hop. Nobody can prove otherwise.
race_barks: Curb hop! Curb hop! Can't stop me!
I'll be at the finish eating a snowball.

crew.name: Spokes McGee
crew.bio: A squirrel mechanic who builds bikes out of shopping carts and pure spite.
race_barks: Built this ride myself. Out of a cart!
Hear that clicking? That's you losing.

crew.name: Lil Tread
crew.bio: The youngest Wheelie King, a rabbit on a bike two sizes too big for her.
race_barks: I'm small but my wheelie is huge!

crew.name: Chainlink Charlie
crew.bio: A tall heron who pedals with his whole neck. Somehow it works.
race_barks: Long legs, long wheelies, long gone.
See you at the harbor, if you make it.
My neck's doing all the work. Still faster.

crew.name: Grease Monkey Gus
crew.bio: A real monkey with real grease. Leaves black handprints on everything he passes.
race_barks: Oops, did I oil that corner? Heh.

leader.name: Big Wheel Bertie
leader.bio: A broad badger on a giant front wheel who runs every block from Key Highway to the Hill.
leader.intro: Bertie: These streets roll on two wheels. Today, one. Ride with me if you can.
leader.taunt: Bertie: Back wheel only, toad. That's how kings ride!
leader.defeat: Bertie: Alright, alright. The old toad can roll. Respect, grandpa.

pigeon_taunts: Coo! Climbing up here with that cane? Bold move, gramps.
The penthouse is MINE. The view, the breadcrumbs, all of it.
Watch your step! That ledge is older than you.
I've got the high ground and the high crumbs.
Down below you're a toad. Up here you're a snack.
Flap flap! Oh wait, you can't. Ha!
Every window on this tower knows my name.
Penthouse rules: no frogs, no toads, no exceptions.
You call that climbing? I've seen moss move faster.
Coo-coo! Here comes a flowerpot. Duck!
My grandpappy roosted here. His grandpappy too.
The wind's picking up, toad. Hope you're glued on.
I can see the whole harbor. And you, sweating.
Halfway there? Cute. The top half is the hard half.
Leave now and I'll only drop a little on your hat.
Coo! You made it this far? Okay, now I'm nervous.
pigeon_popups: Get off my window box, you toad!
Is that a toad? On the 20th floor?
Hon, call somebody. There's a toad!
Shoo! Shoo! This is a nice building!
Want some lemonade? No? Okay then.
Climbing again, Harold? At your age?
You dropped your cane? Here, catch!

bike_life_courses.name: PRATT STREET SPRINT
bike_life_courses.desc: Flat out past the harbor, dodging buses and water taxi crowds.

bike_life_courses.name: COBBLESTONE RATTLE
bike_life_courses.desc: Fells Point bricks shake every bolt loose. Hold that wheelie.

bike_life_courses.name: FEDERAL HILL CLIMB
bike_life_courses.desc: Straight up the hill, then a downhill bomb with the whole city below.

bike_life_courses.name: ROWHOUSE ALLEY RUN
bike_life_courses.desc: Tight alleys, trash cans and stoop sitters cheering from both sides.

bike_life_courses.name: KEY HIGHWAY CRUISE
bike_life_courses.desc: A long, smooth harbor road. Perfect for the longest wheelie.

bike_life_courses.name: MARKET DAY DASH
bike_life_courses.desc: Weave through produce carts and lunch lines. Don't hit the coddies.

bike_life_crowd: Don't you dare drop it now!
That's how we ride down here!
Keep it rolling, keep it rolling!
